title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Ukraine
part_text: Welcomes legislative initiatives to promote equality for LGBTQI+ persons and other marginalised groups, notably draft laws 5488 (hate crimes), 12252 (civil partnerships), and 9103 (registered partnerships); urges prompt adoption of these laws to ensure compliance with European Court of Human Rights standards; calls for the adoption of a new Anti-Discrimination Law covering sexual orientation, gender identity and disability, and for the further strengthening of Ukraine’s anti-discrimination legal framework;
